title: Board Systems
summary: Board's named systems turn creative material and social activity into Drops, signals, spatial work areas, saved memory, and collaborative surfaces.
facts: Drop Studio is Board's creation and editing environment. Current modes include visual media, Voice, Art, and Descript document work.
Dropbooks are an emerging notebook and cover-based way to organize creative material; their final public behavior is still evolving.
Drop Pad OS is Board's holographic spatial interface. Its spaces place activity and tools within one continuous operating environment.
Signals are interaction or activity events around Board content. Pass, Pin, and Push are current examples.
Whispers are short ambient Board observations or notices generated from activity context; they are not private messages by default.
Friend Zone organizes Board relationships as orbs, circles, constellations, and social orbits, with messaging connections in development.
Work Board is the work and project surface for auditions, casting calls, crew needs, files, tasks, roles, and collaborations.
Bucket Brain is Board's memory and intelligence concept. The current Bucket stores user-chosen Drops and signals; deeper intelligence behavior is still developing.
